main_body: Tall drawer cabinet (4x5 grid of small drawers with yellow knobs) with a salmon top carrying a gold item and a white item
top_band: Light salmon band at rows ~2-5 across the full width, with objects sitting on it, followed by a dark brown line at row 6
evidence: The middle column shows a light top band of about 4 rows (rows 2-5) with small items resting on it, so it reads as a horizontal surface. A dark row at 6 acts as the front edge and eave shadow. Below it is a front face about 22 rows tall. Each drawer has a lit upper lip and a dark lower and right shadow, so the drawers read as inset. The top is short but readable, and the front face is clearly separate.

style.evidence: Outlines and frame are dark brown, which matches the wood, and the drawers have a highlight lip, a mid tone and a shadow. The drawers repeat identically, with little grain or speckle on the frame. The salmon top is a wide flat fill with almost no texture. Tiles are mostly 3-6 colours, which is thinner than the stall and well references, which carry more texture and variation.
